coverage_delta: +115 tests over the B3b baseline of 427 (includes this WI's new component/hook tests plus the prior interrupted session's pure-logic tests now wired in and, where needed, corrected). 74 test files all green.
notes: KEY DECISIONS. (D1, BLOCKING FIX) reconcileActiveRide/useRideRestore REWRITTEN: the partial session made IDB a GATE (returned 'none' when IDB empty, never calling the server) which violated AC#6 'if IndexedDB is empty but ActiveOrderId is set the ride is rebuilt from the server'. Now GET /drivers/me is always fetched and authoritative: null activeOrderId -> clear stale IDB + 'none'; set -> getOrder(activeOrderId), terminal -> clear + 'terminal', non-terminal -> 'active' (persisting the id to IDB when it was a cold rebuild). arrivedAt is carried from IDB only when the local id matches the server id. The old test that asserted getDriverMe NOT called was deleted — it codified the AC-violating behavior. (D2) NoShowTimer.tsx NOT created — it would case-collide with noShowTimer.ts on Windows (TS1261, the documented priceBadge trap). The 5-min timer is the pure noShowTimer.ts + a new useActiveOrder.ts ticking hook; the no-show button is folded into RideButton.tsx (countdown label via driver.ride.noShowCountdown). (D3) Complete slice relocated: partial work lived in ride/complete/; moved completeForm(+test) to complete/ and renamed completePayload(+test) -> overrideReason(+test) per the designer files_touched; stray ride/complete/ folder removed. overrideReason.ts now centers the override decision: priceWasChanged() (Fixed-only, floored compare) + isOverrideReasonValid() (>=5 trimmed) + buildCompletePayload() which sends overrideReason ONLY when the Fixed price actually changed AND was revealed (stricter than the partial version which keyed on reveal alone). (D4, D12 applied) Hub + offer listener + OfferTakeover HOISTED from DriverHomePage to DriverLayout so the single /hubs/fleet connection stays alive on /d/ride and /d/ride/complete and an offer can take over on any sub-route. Removed the duplicate mount from DriverHomePage (double-mount would have run two offer renders). DriverLayout.test.tsx updated to mock useFleetHub/useOfferListener/useOfferStore so its silent-refresh boot tests stay isolated (no QueryClient needed). (D5) Object-selector zustand loop fixed: useRideTransition + useRideRestore switched from useActiveOrderStore(s=>({...})) (new object each render -> infinite re-render at runtime, invisible to mocked tests) to atomic one-field selectors, matching DriverHomePage precedent. (D6) Toast consumer added (advisor #4): useRouteToast reads navigate('/d',{state:{toast}}) keys (F-04 reassigned, B-complete 'Hotovo'), shows 2s then clears history state. Rendered as role=status banner in DriverHomePage. Without this both F-04's Czech toast and B-complete's 2s confirmation would silently no-op. IMPORTANT timer bug caught+fixed: the dismiss setTimeout must NOT be keyed on the incoming location.state — navigate() clears state->re-render with incoming=null->effect cleanup would clearTimeout ~immediately and the banner would stick forever. Fixed by running an independent 2s timer keyed on the captured toast STATE (armed once per distinct key via a ref, ref reset on clear so the same key can re-show later). Test was strengthened: the mocked navigate now nulls location.state (reproducing real router behavior) and asserts the banner is gone at 2000ms. (D7) Leaflet kept out of the eager /d ride chunk: RideMapStrip React.lazy(()=>import('./RideMapInner')); RideMapInner is the only leaflet/react-leaflet importer in /d and builds to its own 1.64kB chunk. Collapsed by default so the map never mounts (jsdom has no layout) until the driver expands it — RideMapStrip.test mocks the inner. (D8) NavHandoff is a real anchor (target _blank, rel noopener) using navLinks.buildNavUrl + getNavAppPreference, so OS deep/universal links fire; InProgress navigates to dropoff (if known) else pickup. (D9) Tap-to-call: tel: anchor on customerPhone. (D10) B-queue seam: useRideTransition (arrive/start/cancelNoShow) and useCompleteRide each mint a fresh X-Idempotency-Key per call and expose a thin surface; a transition/complete 409 returns 'stale' (caller refetches); this is ready to be rerouted through the offline queue in B-queue without changing call sites. (D11) i18n: added driver.complete.keypad.{delete,clear}, driver.complete.{fixedLocked,staleRefetched,offlineHint} to BOTH cs.json and en.json; locales.parity.test green. All other driver.ride.* / driver.complete.* keys already existed from the B3b session. KEPT from partial work (tests passed, behavior correct): rideButtonState.ts, noShowTimer.ts, navLinks.ts, idbRideStore.ts, useActiveOrderStore.ts, useLiveClear.ts(+test, F-04), completeForm.ts. CHANGED: useRideRestore (D1), useRideTransition (D5 selectors), completePayload->overrideReason (D3). NOTE: ownLat/ownLng passed as null to RideMapStrip for now — live own-position wiring belongs to B-position (usePositionStore); the map renders pickup/dropoff pins today.
